definition: XoL_Control.xlsx in data\input: every input of a pricing run on its sheets (Params, Layers, Trend, Completion, FX, Limits, Scenarios …). Yellow cells are required, blue optional; the Guide sheet lists everything.

XoL_Results.xlsx in the output folder: stage 07 fills its data sheets (pricing, structures, cedant impact); its own inputs (currency, EPI, return periods, loadings) are edited in the workbook and need no re-run.

Which data the page works on: the synthetic book (the fictional test portfolio shipped in the admin pack, data\synthetic) or the live book (your client data in data\input, outputs in data\output\live).

Stage 01's reader for the shape of the input data: 01a line data (members, claim lines), 01b claimant listing (claimants, monthly exposure, aggregate claims), 01c Merit / ETE outputs (dim_life, fact_member_month, fact_claims). Must match Params source_mode (L, C, E).

A layer paying the part of each insured person's annual claims above the attachment point up to the limit (cover PP on the Layers sheet). Priced by burning cost and by frequency × severity simulation.
A layer on the total of claims from one event (cover EV): claims are grouped into events, the event burning cost and simulation priced in stage 05.
Cover SL: a layer on the book's aggregate claims (or loss ratio) for the treaty year, priced in stage 06 from the attritional model plus the large claims above the stop-loss large threshold.

Params fit_cutoff: the amount above which claims are used to fit the severity distribution (stage 04a). Blank = the lowest active per-person attachment. A cut-off above a layer's attachment leaves a band of claims the fit does not see: Params below_cutoff says what to do with it.

Params choice for layers attaching below the fitting cut-off: STOP (stage 04 stops, S08), IGNORE (the band is left out, its deterministic cost flagged, S09), EMPIRICAL (the band is simulated from the data's own adjusted claims and spliced with the fitted tail, S10 / S11).
The distributions stage 04a fits above the cut-off (Params fit_candidates: LOGNORMAL, GAMMA, WEIBULL, PARETO, GPD); the one with the lowest AIC feeds the simulation unless fit_selected overrides it.

Stage 04: frequency × severity Monte-Carlo per layer (Params iterations, seed; Poisson or negative-binomial frequency), blended with the burning cost by credibility. The longest stage: 5–8 minutes at 10,000 iterations on the owner's laptop.
Stage 02: exposure and claims by treaty year on the chosen basis (treaty_basis, claims_trigger), with indicated completion factors you may copy into the Completion sheet.
A Scenarios-sheet row set applied when Params scenario_id names it: overrides of chosen parameters for a sensitivity run (blank or 0 = best estimate).
Params evaluate_mode = PROGRAMME: the stacked structure of the Programme sheet (PP → EV → SL) is evaluated as one programme in stage 06, besides each layer standalone.

Each stage writes checks_<stage>.csv: STOP rows stop the run there, FLAG rows are warnings, INFO rows notes. P-codes are Params checks (stage 00), A-codes adapter checks, S-codes simulation checks (S07 = 04a not run since 03; S08–S11 = below_cutoff).

Adapter 01c: Merit's final outputs (dim_life, fact_member_month, fact_claims, run_manifest_claims) copied into data\input\ete by tools\import_merit.bat; every further adjustment is made in the Control workbook, never in Merit.
